Delivery, Returns & Ordering

These are useful questions to confirm with Vani Clothing Store. No delivery, COD or return promise is made until the store confirms it.

Delivery & shipping

Confirm service to your PIN code, shipping charges, dispatch time and estimated delivery date. Ask for a courier or tracking reference after dispatch if one is available.

Returns & exchanges

Before payment, ask whether the chosen T-shirt is eligible for exchange or return, the allowed period, condition required, who pays return shipping and any exclusions for custom prints.

Product & payment verification

Ask for the real item photos, correct size/fit, fabric, print placement, stock and final payable amount. Do not pay based only on demo listing details. Orders are confirmed directly by the store.
